parameters.content:
## Edit the Config node first
Open **Config: URL and Secret** and paste Opsflow's `N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET` into `callbackSecret`. `baseUrl` is the public Opsflow URL. Nothing in this workflow reads n8n environment variables, so it works on an n8n Cloud trial.

Hand-written workflow: it is not proven until it has been run in n8n and the run recorded.
